common.tagline: Write it. Own it. Get paid.

welcome.headline: Where songs are born.
welcome.sub: Register your songs, sign your splits and collect your royalties worldwide. Your songs stay 100% yours.

auth.signupSub: Getting started takes less than five minutes.
auth.resent: Done — we sent you a new code.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: There’s already an account with that email. Log in with your password.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don’t match.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code isn’t valid or has expired.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email first with the code we sent you.
errors.OAUTH_UNAVAILABLE: This option isn’t available right now. Use your email instead.

auth.forgotSub: Enter your account email and we’ll send you a code.
auth.resetSub: If there’s an account for {email}, we sent a 6-digit code. It expires in 15 minutes.
auth.resetResent: If the account exists, we sent a new code.

profile.title: Tell us who you are
profile.sub: We use your legal name on agreements and your artist name on your profile.
profile.legalNameHint: Exactly as it appears on your ID.
profile.birthHint: If you’re under 18, your legal guardian will sign the agreement with you.

society.title: Your collecting society
society.sub: The organization that collects your public performance royalties (your PRO).
society.label: Society
society.noneHint: No problem — we’ll help you join one.
society.ipiHint: It’s on your membership certificate. If you don’t have it, leave it blank.

guardian.title: Your legal guardian
guardian.sub: Because you’re under 18, your parent or legal guardian needs to sign the agreement with you. We’ll email them a code.
guardian.name: Guardian’s full name

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.sub: Billed yearly, upfront. You can upgrade to Pro anytime.
plan.example: If your songs earn USD 100, you get USD {net}.
plan.ownership: On both plans you keep 100% ownership of your songs.

contract.title: Your agreement, in plain words
contract.sub: Take your time. You sign with your verified account and we keep the evidence.
contract.accept: I’ve read and accept the administration agreement and terms of use.
contract.guardianSub: We’ll send a code to {email}. With that code, your guardian signs on your behalf.
contract.codeSent: We sent the code to your guardian. It expires in 15 minutes.

payment.title: Activate your membership
payment.sub: Paid yearly upfront by card. We’ll remind you 15 days before renewal.
payment.renewsValue: in one year, with advance notice
payment.secure: Secure payment. Pluma never sees or stores your card details.

done.title: Welcome to Pluma!
done.sub: Your membership is active. Now register your first song and sign your splits.
done.processing: We’re confirming your payment. This takes a few seconds.

home.noStatementYet: No statements yet. Your balance shows up here once the first one is published.
home.pendingOne: You have 1 split waiting for your signature
home.pendingMany: You have {count} splits waiting for your signature
home.emptyWorks: You haven’t registered any songs yet. Start with the one you most want to protect.
home.graceNotice: Your membership expired. Renew before {date} to keep the Network and your catalogs on.
home.suspendedNotice: Your membership is paused. We keep administering your registered songs.

works.title: Songs
works.empty: Your songs will show up here. Register your first one in two minutes.
works.pending: {count, plural, one {# signature missing} other {# signatures missing}}

workForm.sub: Just the basics. You can fill in the rest later.
workForm.title: Title
workForm.altTitlesHint: Separate them with commas. It helps us find your royalties even when a platform spells the title differently.
workForm.lyricsHint: Goes into your time-stamped proof of authorship. It’s never published.
workForm.isrcsHint: If the song is already recorded. Separate them with commas: US-ABC-26-00001
workForm.ai: Did you use artificial intelligence to write it?

aiOptions.none: No, I wrote it without AI
aiOptions.ai_assisted: Yes, AI helped with parts of it
aiOptions.ai_generated: Yes, it was mostly generated by AI

workForm.aiHint: This declaration is required and doesn’t affect your registration.

files.title: Audio demo
files.sub: Optional. Its fingerprint goes into your proof of authorship and it’s never published without your permission.
files.label: Audio file
files.hint: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG or FLAC, up to 40 MB.

splits.title: Who wrote it?
splits.sub: Add each co-writer and their share. Everyone signs before registration.
splits.name: Name
splits.emailHint: We’ll send them the invitation to sign. If they’re a Pluma member, we’ll recognize them.
splits.informative: For the record · not a member

review.title: Review and send for signature
review.sub: When you send it, you sign your share and each co-writer gets an invitation. The song moves to registration once everyone signs.
review.authorshipBody: We fingerprint your lyrics and demo and time-stamp them.
review.notReady: The split must add up to exactly 100% before you send it.

workDetail.yourTurn: Your turn to sign your share: {pct}
workDetail.rejectHint: The song goes to review and nobody gets paid until it’s settled.
workDetail.newVersionHint: A change creates a new version and everyone has to sign again. The current version keeps applying in the meantime.
workDetail.newVersionReason: Why are you changing the split?
workDetail.pendingVersion: A new version of the split is waiting for signatures.
workDetail.draftVersion: You have a new split version in draft.
workDetail.syncHint: Music supervisors and agencies can find it and request a license.
workDetail.arHint: Invited label A&Rs can listen and ask to record it.
workDetail.oneStop: One-stop: I also control the master and clear it for sync
workDetail.notSealed: It’ll be sealed in a few minutes.
workDetail.conflict: We found a very similar song registered by someone else. Our team is reviewing it.
workDetail.disputed: This song is in dispute. Its royalties are on hold until it’s resolved.

guest.title: Sign your share of “{title}”
guest.invitedBy: {name} listed you as a co-writer on Pluma.
guest.noAccount: You don’t need an account or to pay anything to sign. Your share is recorded for information.
guest.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
guest.signedBody: We saved your signature with the date, time and document fingerprint. We’ll let you know when everyone has signed.
guest.joinPitch: Want to collect your royalties with Pluma? Become a member anytime.
guest.rejectedBody: The song is now under review. Our team will contact everyone involved.
guest.expiredBody: Ask the person who registered the song to resend the invitation.
guest.closedTitle: This invitation is no longer active
guest.closedBody: The split changed or was already closed. If you have a newer invitation, use that link.

account.title: Account
account.languageHint: Used in the app and in your emails.
account.upgradeBody: It switches right away and you only pay the difference for what’s left of your year: {amount}.
account.upgraded: You’re on Pro! Turn on sync and A&R for your songs.
account.downgradeBody: The change applies at the end of your paid period, on {date}.
account.privacyBody: You can request a copy of your data or ask us to delete it. We respond under Habeas Data, LGPD and CCPA.

network.title: The Pluma Network
network.body: Post what you’re looking for (“I’ve got a beat, need a hook”) and find co-writers with verified credits. Coming in the next phase.

sync.title: Sync
sync.body: Get your songs in front of music supervisors and agencies. Turn on the sync catalog for each song (Pro plan).

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Your official statements, balance and withdrawals will live here. The first statement arrives on the official payment calendar.

devCheckout.title: Test payment
devCheckout.body: Nothing is charged: this step simulates a card payment (demo and development).

payments.title: Payments
payments.noCalendar: We’ll let you know once the official date is confirmed.
payments.noStatements: No statements yet. The first one arrives on the official payment calendar.
payments.noPayouts: You haven’t requested any withdrawals yet.
payments.alertNoIncome: “{title}” had no income in the last two periods. Make sure it’s complete and registered.

statement.generating: We’re generating the PDF. Refresh in a few seconds.
statement.rounding: Breakdown amounts are rounded; the net is the official figure.

withdraw.taxIdHint: SSN/ITIN, RFC, CPF, NIT… Stored encrypted.
withdraw.requested: Done. We’ve requested your withdrawal; we’ll review it and let you know when it’s sent.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.locked: Advanced analytics is a Pro feature: trends by song, period comparison and projection.
analytics.projectionNote: This is an estimate based on the average of your recent periods. It’s not an official amount.
analytics.noData: You need at least one published statement.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyBody: Signatures, statements, payments and updates on your songs show up here.

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.intro: Choose how we reach you. Anything about your money, your signatures or your plan always comes by email too.
prefs.mandatory: Always by email: it matters for your money or your rights.
prefs.pushOff: Turn on push on this device to use it.
prefs.whatsappOff: Add your WhatsApp number to use it.
prefs.inAppAlways: Every notification is also saved in your notification center inside the app.

catHint.works: Status changes and possible registration conflicts.

prefs.pushBody: Get alerts instantly, even when Pluma isn’t open.

prefs.whatsappBody: Optional. We only message you about what matters: statements, payouts and signatures.
prefs.consent: I agree to receive Pluma alerts on WhatsApp. I can turn them off anytime.
